page.layout: One printed page, a title page: ornamental border at top, black-letter imprint lines in the centre, a rule, the date in capitals, and a second ornamental border at the foot.
page.notes: The imprint lines are set in black letter (Fraktur); the transcription uses roman letters for them as read. The ornamental borders are woodcut or type ornaments, not text. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed.
